```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(survival)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(S4Vectors))

```

input = pipeline$Survival_analysis$input

```{r}
dou_exprs = fread(input$dou_exprs,sep = "\t",header = T)  %>% column_to_rownames("V1") 
ferra_exprs = fread(input$ferra_exprs,sep = "\t",header = T) %>% column_to_rownames("V1") 
brayer_exprs = fread(input$brayer_exprs,sep = "\t",header = T) %>% column_to_rownames("V1") 

```


```{r}
dou_survival = readxl::read_excel(input$dou_acc_survival,sheet = 1,col_names = T,skip = 1) %>% as.data.frame()
dou_survival= dou_survival[dou_survival$"Case Number" != "P-50",]

tx_clinical = fread(input$TX_clinical)
dk_clinical = fread(input$DK_clinical)
all_clinical = rbind(tx_clinical,dk_clinical)
ferra_clinical = readxl::read_excel(input$ferra_clinical,sheet = 1,col_names = T,skip = 0) %>% as.data.frame()
ferra_clinical$TID = gsub(pattern = "-", replacement = "_", ferra_clinical$TID)
```

```{r}
ferra_clinical_clean <- ferra_clinical %>%
  mutate(
    # set OS_event to 1 for patients who died (WD, DOD) and 0 for patients who are alive (NED, LF, AWD)
    OS_event = case_when(
      Status2 %in% c("WD", "DOD") ~ 1,
      Status2 %in% c("NED", "LF", "AWD") ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # convert TTDeath from days to months to match other datasets (average month = 30.4375 days)
    OS_time_months = as.numeric(TTDeath) / 30.4375
  )
```

# Dou survival analysis

```{r}

dou_survival_clean <- dou_survival %>%
  mutate(
    LRRFS_event = ifelse(`Locoregional recurrence` == "Yes", 1, 0),
    DMFS_event  = ifelse(`Distant metastasis` == "Yes", 1, 0),
    LRRFS_time  = `Locoregional recurrence-free survival (LRRFS)`,
    DMFS_time   = `Distant metastasis-free survival time (DMFS)`
  )

dou_survival_clean[,"Case Number"] = gsub(dou_survival_clean$"Case Number", pattern = "-", replacement = "_")
```




```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
#| fig-width: 8
run_lr_survival <- function(
    expression_data,
    clinical_data,
    lr_pairs,
    sample_col,
    time_col,
    event_col,
    survival_type,# i.e "OS" or "DMFS" or "LRRFS"
    data_name,
    log_transform = TRUE
) {
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(expression_data), is.data.frame(clinical_data))
  if (!sample_col %in% names(clinical_data)) {
    stop("sample_col is not a column in clinical_data")
  }
  if (!all(c(time_col, event_col) %in% names(clinical_data))) {
    stop("time_col and event_col must be columns in clinical_data")
  }

  expression_data <- as.data.frame(expression_data)
  if (is.null(rownames(expression_data))) {
    stop("expression_data must have gene names as row names")
  }

  expression_samples <- colnames(expression_data)
  clinical_samples <- as.character(clinical_data[[sample_col]])
  overlapping_samples <- intersect(expression_samples, clinical_samples)
  if (length(overlapping_samples) == 0) {
    stop(
      "No overlapping sample IDs between expression_data columns and clinical_data$",
      sample_col,
      ". Check sample-name formatting."
    )
  }

  results <- lapply(lr_pairs, function(pair) {
    ligand <- unname(pair[["ligand"]])
    receptor <- unname(pair[["receptor"]])
    pair_name <- paste(ligand, receptor, sep = " - ")

    if (!all(c(ligand, receptor) %in% rownames(expression_data))) {
      return(data.frame(
        Pair = pair_name, logHR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_,
        upper = NA_real_, pvalue = NA_real_, n = 0L
      ))
    }
  
    expr <- expression_data[c(ligand, receptor), , drop = FALSE]
    if (log_transform) expr <- log2(expr + 1)

    expression_df <- as.data.frame(t(expr), check.names = FALSE) |>
      tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id")
    names(expression_df)[2:3] <- c("Ligand_exp", "Receptor_exp")
    expression_df$LR_Product <- expression_df$Ligand_exp * expression_df$Receptor_exp
    names(expression_df)[1] <- sample_col

    model_data <- clinical_data |>
      dplyr::inner_join(expression_df, by = sample_col) |>
      dplyr::filter(
        !is.na(.data[[time_col]]),
        !is.na(.data[[event_col]]),
        !is.na(LR_Product)
      )

    if (nrow(model_data) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(model_data$LR_Product) < 2) {
      return(data.frame(
        Pair = pair_name, logHR = NA_real_, lower = NA_real_,
        upper = NA_real_, pvalue = NA_real_, n = nrow(model_data)
      ))
    }

    fit <- survival::coxph(
      survival::Surv(model_data[[time_col]], model_data[[event_col]]) ~ LR_Product,
      data = model_data
    )
    coefficient <- summary(fit)$coefficients["LR_Product", ]
    log_hr <- coefficient[["coef"]]
    se <- coefficient[["se(coef)"]]

    data.frame(
      Pair = pair_name,
      logHR = log_hr,
      lower = log_hr - 1.96 * se,
      upper = log_hr + 1.96 * se,
      pvalue = coefficient[["Pr(>|z|)"]],
      n = nrow(model_data)
    )
  }) |>
    dplyr::bind_rows()

  plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(results, ggplot2::aes(x = logHR, y = reorder(Pair, logHR))) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
    ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), orientation = "y", height = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 22, size = 3, fill = "white") +
    ggplot2::labs(title = paste(data_name, survival_type, "Hazard Ratios (log scale) with 95% Confidence Intervals"),
                  x = "log(HR) (95% CI)", y = "") +
    ggplot2::theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 18),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 16),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 14)
    )

  list(results = results, plot = plot)
}


```

```{r}
lr_pairs <- list(
  c(ligand = "CCN1", receptor = "ITGB1"),
  c(ligand = "TGFB1", receptor = "TGFBR2"),
  c(ligand = "CXCL12", receptor = "CXCR4"),
  c(ligand = "SLPI", receptor = "PLSCR1")
)

```
# Dou survival analysis

```{r}
#|fig-height: 8
#|fig-width: 9
lr_survival <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = dou_exprs,
  clinical_data = dou_survival_clean,
  sample_col = "Case Number",
  time_col = "LRRFS_time",
  event_col = "LRRFS_event",
  survival_type = "LRRFS",
  data_name = "Dou",
  lr_pairs = lr_pairs
)

lr_survival$plot

lr_survival <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = dou_exprs,
  clinical_data = dou_survival_clean,
  sample_col = "Case Number",
  time_col = "DMFS_time",
  event_col = "DMFS_event",
  survival_type = "DMFS",
  data_name = "Dou",
  lr_pairs = lr_pairs
)

lr_survival$plot
```
# Ferrarotto survival analysis


```{r}
#|fig-height: 8
#|fig-width: 9
lr_survival_ferra <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = ferra_exprs,
  clinical_data = ferra_clinical_clean,
  lr_pairs = lr_pairs,
  sample_col = "TID",
  time_col = "OS_time_months",
  event_col = "OS_event",
  survival_type = "OS",
  data_name = "Ferrarotto"
)
lr_survival_ferra$plot
```

# Brayer survival analysis

```{r}
lr_survival_brayer <- run_lr_survival(
  expression_data = brayer_exprs,
  clinical_data = all_clinical,
  lr_pairs = lr_pairs,
  sample_col = "UID",
  time_col = "SURV_MO",
  event_col = "SURV_CENS",
  survival_type = "OS",
  data_name = "Brayer"
)
lr_survival_brayer$plot
```
